scientific.integrity: The primary publisher PDF was inspected at the compartmental model, parameter semantics, total-population balance, fractional integral representation, Laplace–Adomian equations (5.6)–(5.10), and the numerical section that identifies equation (5.10) as the source of the plotted approximations. The relevant equation pages were visually inspected. The predecessor model was checked for compartmental context. Exact symbolic replay verifies the coefficient discrepancies. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns the printed Laplace–Adomian derivation and reproducibility of the plotted approximations from that derivation. Unavailable implementation code could have used corrected equations. The finding does not re-audit the article's existence or uniqueness analysis.

title: The published Laplace–Adomian recurrence is not a series solution of the stated COVID-19 model
